decision_signal.threshold: CATALOGABLE >= 40% of empty => viable semantic-layer target
decision_signal.verdict: GO — project 13 IS a viable semantic-layer target
decision_signal.contrast_proj12: proj.12 empty pop was ~74% custom-fab sheet-metal ductwork, ~3% catalogable, semantic recovered 1/301. proj.13 is the OPPOSITE: a catalogable ВК (plumbing) population.

honest_caveats: The real ceiling on proj.13 empty rows is NOT "no product exists" (as on proj.12). It is two RECOVERABLE parser/structure issues: (a) 41 bare-dimension sub-rows whose size lives on a child row, and (b) concatenation artifacts where two products merged into one cell (e.g. "Кранспускной d15 ... Трубы стальные ...").

34 of 76 catalogable empty rows have a product TWIN that the matcher DID match elsewhere in this same run — direct proof these are catalogable and were merely missed by the LLM pass, not structurally unmatchable.
BY_WEIGHT_MOUNT (32) are real items but spec'd by weight (kg); whether a unit-priced catalog analog exists is supplier-dependent — reported separately to avoid inflating the catalogable number.
No эталон was used (not needed for composition). Accuracy@1 vs эталон was NOT measured here; this is a composition/viability diagnostic only.
